content.text:
I didn't find the ball, and the robot never moved. It couldn't stand up. I tried `stand` twice, and both times the motors stayed off. NAOqi reported diagnosis errors on 23 joints, including the head, both arms and both legs.

I called `rest`, so the robot is crouched with its motors off. The camera never moved from its starting view. It showed a room with desks and chairs, but no red ball was visible.

The robot needs a hardware check, for example a reboot by holding the chest button. After that I can retry the search.
